_readme: Your private sync config. Copy to hd-sync.json at the repo root (git-ignored) and fill it in.
The sync tools (src/gen_entries.py, src/hdlib.py, src/audit_job.py) read it. Nothing here is a secret,
but it is your business's chart of accounts and customer list, so keep it out of any public fork.
An AI agent with your QuickBooks connector can fill every <ID> for you: see AGENTS.md, 'Setting up for a new business'.
Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.
_cutoff_date: Never create or change entries dated before this. It only moves forward.
_accounts: QBO account ids. cogs = default materials expense/COGS. tools = where 'Tools' POs go (no project). rental = tool-rental expense (optional; delete the key to use cogs). store_credit = ONE Bank/Cash-on-hand account that pools every Home Depot gift/store-credit card.
_vendor_hd: QBO vendor id for The Home Depot.
_cards: Card last-4 -> the QBO credit-card/bank account its charges land in. Several employee cards often share one account. tender_roster.csv (from src/parse_receipts.py) or new_rows.csv lists every last-4 seen.
_never_book: Last-4s that are NOT company cards (a client's card, a personal card saved on the Pro account). Their purchases are itemized for the record but never posted; any return on them is flagged.
_ask_first: Last-4s to hold and ask about every time (e.g. an employee's personal card used by mistake).
_jobs: Canonical job name -> QBO customer id (in QBO, a project is a customer). Matching uses the street number plus the first word of the street, so '123 EXAMPLE STREET' and '123 example st' both find '123 Example St'.
_po_aliases: Your standing rules for PO text that should go to a specific job: normalized PO prefix (letters/digits only, upper case) -> canonical job. Use for the shop/office PO, or a stale job name the register keeps auto-filling.
_garbage_pos: PO values that mean 'no job given'. Rows with these are held for a human.
_tools_pos: PO values that mean 'tools, no project' -> accounts.tools.
_excluded_origin_refunds: When a return refunds onto YOUR card or store credit an item that was originally bought on a never_book card: 'ask' (hold it) or 'untagged' (credit cogs with no job).
